reviews.text: We loved dinner, but we waited about half an hour for a table on Saturday.
Our party of four came around seven and left when there wasn't a table available.
We sat at the counter on Sunday and the team was lovely.

mission.title: The Seating Problem
mission.summary: Weekend guests mention long waits and trouble finding a table. Explore how a few more seats could change monthly contribution.
mission.applicability: Explore capacity changes during busy service periods after checking the available space and customer demand.
